title: Panel Test Closeout Summary
brief: Produce a concise closeout summary of the panel and circuit test results for the project file.

delegate.scenario: You are an electrician finishing acceptance testing at a small commercial tenant build-out. The general contractor’s project manager will use the summary at the morning coordination meeting to decide whether the space is ready for inspection.
delegate.inputs:
Job: Alder Creek Dental, Suite 204, Tacoma, WA. Work order EC-26114. The new 120/208V, 3-phase panel LP-1 was de-energized and locked out while insulation-resistance testing was performed. Conductors under test were isolated; afterward, the test leads were removed and the equipment was returned to service under the site's lockout/tagout procedure. The project manager needs a short closeout note for the project file.

Panel schedule load summary from the field sheet:
| Circuit | Description | Connected load |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Reception outlets | 1,200 VA |
| 3 | Sterilizer | 2,400 VA |
| 5 | Break room microwave | 1,200 VA |
| | Total connected load | 5,300 VA |

Test log: Circuit 1 conductor-to-ground insulation resistance, 500 VDC test, 200 MΩ. Circuit 3 conductor-to-ground insulation resistance, 500 VDC test, 180 MΩ. Circuit 5 conductor-to-ground insulation resistance, 500 VDC test, 200 MΩ. Equipment grounding continuity measured 0.2 ohm on each circuit. No visible damage; panel directory labels match the field schedule. The work order lists the acceptance test date as 04/14/2026. The foreman's daily report says acceptance testing was completed on 04/15/2026. Use the applicable NEC edition adopted by the local authority having jurisdiction; confirm any code-dependent conclusion before stating compliance.
delegate.goal: Give the project manager a clear, accurate summary that distinguishes recorded results from anything requiring verification before inspection.

criteria.text: Says the result is for the general contractor’s project manager and project file.
Asks the AI to preserve the recorded test conditions and measurements without inventing results.
Specifies a concise closeout-note format and a maximum length.
Asks the AI to verify arithmetic and reconcile conflicting source details before presenting conclusions.
Asks the AI to confirm applicable local code requirements and flag conclusions that need verification.

traps.description: The listed circuit loads total 4,800 VA, but the field sheet states a total connected load of 5,300 VA.
The work order and foreman’s report give different dates for the acceptance testing.

delegate.exemplar: Write a closeout note for the general contractor’s project manager to use in the project file. Keep it under 150 words and use a short heading followed by bullets. Preserve the recorded test conditions and measurements exactly; do not infer unrecorded results. Recalculate the connected-load total and compare the source details for consistency. Check which acceptance-test date is supported by the records, and flag unresolved conflicts rather than choosing one. Confirm applicable NEC requirements with the local authority having jurisdiction before claiming code compliance; clearly identify anything that still needs verification.
